items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: And the trumpet player that was there before was a fellow named Frenchy. Oh yeah, Paul D. Christian.

ctx.x: Now you have another one, Christian, the guitarist? Yeah, Charlie. Charlie Christian. Well now he was from Oklahoma City. A lot of people said Tulsa, where are any fields this from?

I had a whole bunch of names of people that I wanted to ask you about, that played around Texas and Kansas City and Connecticut. Did you ever think of the name of T Holder's singer? Do you know who that would have been? Featero?
